papers.title: The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
papers.summary: The probabilistic retrieval account makes collection size and document frequency explicit inputs to IDF/BM25. Fixed document content therefore does not imply fixed lexical scores after collection changes.
papers.scope_limit: Use as mathematical foundation, not a new empirical retry benchmark or proof that all duplication worsens QA.

papers.title: Byte-Exact Deduplication in Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Three-Regime Empirical Analysis Across Public Benchmarks
papers.summary: Defines byte-exact filtering over retrieved chunks. It acknowledges indexed duplicates and describes a triple-indexed synthetic corpus (§5.1); its scaling condition also triples a saturated retrieved set (§3.3).
